outcome: Women's birth choice request (normal birth vs. cesarean section)
cohort: The study included women who gave birth in a single primary care center region in two separate time periods: 2007-2008 and 2017-2018.
finding: The rate of women requesting normal birth decreased over the 10-year period, particularly among women under 25 years old, high school graduates, unemployed women, and those in the middle economic level; this decrease coincided with an increase in the belief that normal birth is more painful.
